title: Overdue-Day Count for Marketplace Orders Replacement Charges
content:
**Rule.** The overdue-day count of the Marketplace Orders replacement charge runs from the unreturned-replacement deadline and ends as follows: where a first carrier scan of the original unit stands after the deadline, the count ends on that scan date, since the unit is then on its way back; where the return was set up as a carrier pickup and no carrier scan stands, no overdue day is counted, since collecting the unit is Northloop's carrier's task; otherwise the count ends on the settlement date.

The unreturned-replacement deadline is the date recorded on the replacement entry plus the option's unreturned replacement days, in calendar days; overdue days are the calendar days from that deadline to the end of the count.

## Where the count ends

| Records of the original unit | End of the count | Overdue days |
|---|---|---|
| a first carrier scan stands, dated after the deadline | the first scan date | calendar days from the deadline to the scan date |
| no carrier scan; the return method on the return request is carrier pickup | — | none |
| no carrier scan; any other return method | the settlement date | calendar days from the deadline to the settlement date |

## Hypothetical cases

Replacement recorded on 4 May, 30 unreturned replacement days, deadline 3 June; settlement on 20 June.

1. First scan on 12 June: 9 overdue days.
2. Carrier pickup set up, no scan: 0 overdue days.
3. UPS drop-off chosen, no scan: 17 overdue days, counted to 20 June.

The dates are example inputs.
